(a) ON is a heterogeneous disease, (b) the disease is characterized by the dysregulation of the cell cycle, (c) the cell cycle is the most prominent pathway, and (d) the disease is associated with a significant number of pathways.

the unification and analysis of heterogeneous multi-omic data can lead to the identification of the disease networks that underlie a specific disease, in our case Obstructive Nymphropathy in children.

(a) ON is a disease with an intricate molecular profile, which is not restricted to the kidney but also includes other organs and tissues; (b) The molecular network of ON is dominated by genes and pathways that regulate the immune response, cell adhesion and cell cycle, which is consistent with the known pathological state; and (c) The molecular profile of ON in children is similar to that of adult ON, with a few differences, which are also consistent with the known pathology.
